meta.name: prioritization-advisor
meta.description: Choose a prioritization framework based on stage, team context, and stakeholder needs. Use when deciding between RICE, ICE, value/effort, or another scoring approach.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据阶段和场景选择最合适的优先级评分框架
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个方案中决定先做什么
copy.tagline_en: Choose the best prioritization framework for your stage and context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide what to work on next

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过提问了解你的产品阶段、团队情况、决策需求和数据可用性，然后推荐最适合的优先级排序框架（如 RICE、ICE、价值/努力矩阵等），并给出实施步骤。
howto.when: 当你询问如何选择优先级排序框架，或描述你的产品阶段、团队背景和决策挑战时触发。

say.text: 我的初创公司应该用哪个优先级框架？
say.note: Claude 会询问产品阶段等信息后推荐框架。

say.text: 帮我比较 RICE 和价值/努力矩阵，用于路线图规划。
say.note: Claude 会分析你的场景并给出建议。

say.text: 我们团队总在优先级上争论，推荐一个框架。
say.note: Claude 会通过问题诊断并推荐合适的框架。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude asks about your product stage, team context, decision needs, and data availability, then recommends a prioritization framework (e.g., RICE, ICE, value/effort) with implementation steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to choose a prioritization framework or describe your product stage, team context, and decision challenges.

say_en.text: Which prioritization framework should my startup use right now?
say_en.note: Claude will ask about product stage and recommend.

say_en.text: Help me choose between RICE and value/effort for roadmap planning.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your context and suggest.

say_en.text: We keep arguing about prioritization. Recommend a framework.
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose and recommend a suitable framework.
